tools.name: urlscan_get_quotas
tools.description: Your urlscan.io API quotas and current usage, per action (public / unlisted / private scans, search, result retrieval, ...) and per minute, hour and day: limit, used, remaining, percent. Check it before submitting scans. GET /api/v1/quotas.

tools.name: urlscan_list_scan_countries
tools.description: Two-letter country codes a scan can be run from (the `country` option of urlscan_submit_scan). Free plans may only be able to pick a country for public scans. GET /api/v1/availableCountries.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: urlscan_search, urlscan_submit_scan, urlscan_get_scan_result · Private data: urlscan_get_quotas, urlscan_search, urlscan_submit_scan, urlscan_get_scan_result · Public sink: urlscan_submit_scan · Destructive: urlscan_list_scan_countries.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: urlscan_search, urlscan_submit_scan, urlscan_get_scan_result · Private data: urlscan_get_quotas, urlscan_search, urlscan_submit_scan, urlscan_get_scan_result · Public sink: urlscan_submit_scan · Destructive: urlscan_list_scan_countries

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
